description: Defines the dc_offset_t enum and helper functions for handling DC offset in 3GPP NR (5G) radio resource management, including packing and containment checks.

classes.name: dc_offset_t
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible DC offset positions relative to the spectrum center, including special values for outside spectrum and undetermined.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs a dc_offset_t value into a 16-bit unsigned integer for message transmission, considering spectrum boundaries.

methods.name: is_contained
methods.description: Checks if a given DC offset or position is within a specified resource block interval.
